note: The COLOUR is exact and does render: red is absorbed first underwater, so rm goes down while blue and green both go up, giving a cyan cast rather than a plain blue one (input 128 -> 105,117,115). Contrast drops for the murk. What this does NOT do is any caustics, godrays, floating particulate or refraction wobble - no filter in the allowed set can, and the bubbles and light rays entries in tags are prompt-side hopes only. Treat this as the water colour and get the movement elsewhere.
